flux@v2.9.6.text: helm-controller no longer reapplies chart CRDs on every upgrade when server-side apply is enabled with the default Create policy.
HelmReleases left with a drifted Ready=Unknown condition after a failed status patch are recovered.
helm-controller ignores NotFound when deleting the HelmChart.
source-controller normalizes Azure Blob listing ETags, so unchanged containers are not re-downloaded on every reconcile.
source-controller evicts stale Helm repository index entries from the cache. Repositories with frequently changing indexes no longer fail with "Cache is full".

kustomize-controller extends SOPS decryption error redaction to spec.postBuild.substituteFrom values. Substituted secrets echoed back in API validation errors are masked out of status conditions and events.
Opt-in DisableCommitStatusEvent feature gate in kustomize-controller.

helm@v4.3.0.text: Debug logging in the engine when lookup returns empty.
Ownership verification before deleting resources during uninstall.
SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH is honored for chart archives, for reproducible packaging.
rollback --description flag to record the reason for a rollback.
Resync period lowered from one hour to 3 minutes.
Status computation runs concurrently to prevent multi-minute delays.
Values files that end exactly at a 4096-byte boundary are no longer dropped by the loader.
StampModTimes timestamps normalized to UTC and truncated, with a Chart.lock reproducibility test.
Provenance verification supports GnuPG keybox (pubring.kbx) keyrings.
Regression: registry messages in template and show go to stderr again instead of stdout.
Zero-width spaces removed from the plugin name comment.

helm@v4.2.4.text: google.golang.org/grpc bumped from 1.80.0 to 1.82.1 for GO-2026-6061.
go.opentelemetry.io/otel bumped to v1.44.0 for GO-2026-5158.
Better error reporting for helm template --debug with --show-only.
Logs are fetched from all containers in test pods.
Provenance: error returns checked in Digest and encodeRelease.
helm push to a registry with token auth sets the [pull,push] scope.
Missing conflict retry with server-side apply.
Extra field in gzipped packages is formatted properly.
Registry client is passed to downloader.Manager in upgrade.

k8sgpt@v0.4.39.text: --resource flag to analyze a single resource.
Resource names in event-derived failures are anonymised.
An unsupported scaleTargetRef is no longer also reported as missing.
Service events are filtered by involved object kind.
Guard against empty completion choices in the OpenAI client.
ReplicaFailure is reported regardless of replica count.
ClusterRole references in RoleBindings are resolved.

openfeature@v0.17.0.text: Server-side sync metrics renamed: feature_flag.flagd.sync.active_streams is now feature_flag.flagd.sync.server.active_streams, and feature_flag.flagd.sync.stream.duration is now feature_flag.flagd.sync.server.stream.duration. Client metrics are added alongside.
gzip compression for OFREP evaluation responses.
The outbound sync channel is instrumented when flagd runs as a client.
flagd waits for flag state before reporting ready.

kubernetes-mcp-server@v0.0.67.text: Tekton toolset gains filtered logs and pipeline context.
pods_top and nodes_top tools are hidden when the Metrics API is unavailable.
JWT assertions are minted fresh every time.
Kubernetes roundtripper handles subresources and resources without Kind set.
Dependency bumps, including tektoncd/pipeline 1.15.0 and helm.sh/helm/v3 3.21.4.

kyverno@v1.19.1.text: Go bumped to 1.26.6 and x/net updated to resolve CVE-2026-39821.
HTTP blocklist applied to the apiCall.service executor; the egress proxy path and CABundle branch are hardened; an IPv6-embedded-IPv4 blocklist bypass is closed; urlPath hardening backported.
Missing autogen webhook expansion for NamespacedValidatingPolicy.
Data race in image evaluator prefetch.
PolicyException CEL match conditions are validated.
Phase 1 deprecation warning plumbing, with warning enforcement in the CLI.

crossplane@v2.4.2.text: Ownership of ServiceAccounts is correctly transferred to newly active package revisions (#7838).
A claim fails closed when it cannot list its XRD.

opa@v1.21.1.text: Compiler regression from v1.21.0: a comprehension using some ... in or every, nested inside an object or set literal, was treated as ground and skipped rewriting. some ... in failed with rego_unsafe_var_error and every caused a compiler panic. Array literals were not affected.

opentofu@v1.13.1.text: tofu show -json <planfile> works again when ephemeral resources are present in the configuration.
Ephemeral output values are always re-evaluated during apply instead of sometimes using stale values from the plan phase.

backstage@v1.55.3.text: TechDocs generation for documented MkDocs Markdown extension configurations.

jenkins@2.585.text: Experimental Jenkins pages standardised: the side panel scrolls independently and the build bar is sticky.
New Manage Jenkins UI enabled by default.
Minimum required Remoting version raised from 3176.v207ec082a_8c0 to 3256.3258.v858f3c9a_f69d. Agents on older Remoting need updating.
Filtering on the experimental Job page.
Cloud display name shown instead of its internal name.
Sortable date column ordering for 12 AM times.
Missing return after sendError in doDoFingerprintCheck.
Missing badges on header dropdown menu items.
Missing New Item button in the new dashboard view.

servicenow-sdk@4.13.0.text: DatabaseView Fluent API for sys_db_view records, with an SDK guide, IDE autocomplete on table field references and app-prefix diagnostics.
MFA challenge support for basic-auth login. now-sdk prompts for a 6-digit TOTP code when the instance requires one.
Playbook Fluent gains variant overrides, a Go Back activity, decision-branch ideal-path support and public playbook support.
OAuth session cookie replay that could make app installs fail silently on instances that restrict API session reuse.

gitlab@19.4.text: Governance for GitLab MCP server tools from the same group and project Duo settings as internal tools. Read-only tools default to Always Allow, write and delete tools default to Always Ask.
Restrict access to MCP servers (beta): allow or deny an entire external MCP server or individual tools on it. Premium and Ultimate.

tekton@v1.17.0.text: reconcile.write_intent span attribute (no-op, status-only, metadata-only, metadata-and-status) on PipelineRun and TaskRun reconcile spans, so operators can tell which reconciliations intend an etcd write.
Pod infrastructure failure reasons from Warning events (FailedMount, FailedScheduling, FailedCreatePodSandBox) are surfaced onto the run status.

pulumi@v3.268.0.text: Engine negotiates OutputValues on Invoke, so SDKs can pass dependency-carrying values in args and receive them back. Gated by the accepts_outputs_in_invoke handshake capability.
version, whoami and install in the generated Automation APIs for NodeJS, Python and Go.
Elided asset contents are restored from prior state when a provider echoes assets back from refresh or update.
Resource transforms declared on an ancestor component apply to resources parented under a resource read.
PCL unifies two recursive object types, or a map with an object, to the same finite type on every run instead of overflowing the stack.
Snapshot integrity error when untargeted steps change dependencies in the program.
Dynamic providers in NodeJS and Python fall back to the inputs field of a Read request when properties is empty, so Get keeps working.
Plugins download from Git repositories whose version tags have no v prefix.
Language host process leak when the schema loader boots a plugin that runs in a language host.
Generated NodeJS docs link @pulumi/pulumi types to their TypeDoc pages.

sap-btp-terraform@v1.27.0.text: Function label extraction supports legacy labels.
Fail fast when amount is set on non-quota entitlement plans.
Drift for role collection group and attribute assignments with custom IAS origins.
auto_create_shadow_users added to the globalaccount trust configuration.

cluster-api@v1.14.3.text: Kubernetes version support: management cluster v1.33 to v1.37, workload cluster v1.31 to v1.37.
cluster-name label is also set on Clusters without ClusterClass.
KCP tries to match the etcd member to the machine being deleted.
Machine and MachineSet handle not-found gracefully when resolving owner references.
grpc bumped to 1.83.2 to address security advisories.

argo-rollouts@v1.10.0.text: Guard empty Values in the injected anti-affinity check.
Controller skips unnecessary ephemeral metadata pod listing.
desired-replicas annotation is synced during abort scale-down.
Controller logs the underlying error when newRolloutContext returns nil.
Namespace-support notification controller is selected via the self-service flag.
Log level downgraded for unconfigured notification triggers.
Panic prevented when notifications write Unstructured objects.
Experiments fall back to the API when the ReplicaSet lister is stale on AlreadyExists.

kro@v0.9.4.text: Chart aggregates a user role into the view, edit and admin ClusterRoles.
shortNames and categories in the RGD.
extraEnv support in the Helm deployment template.
deepMerge() CEL function for recursive nested map merging.
klog is routed to zap; zap-devel is configurable in Helm.
Extended CEL env cache is keyed by schema, not just variable name.
Chart template gaps found during review.
ResourcesReady=False with reason ReconciliationSuspended when an instance is suspended.
Panic when uint or bytes CEL values reach deep-copy.
Ordered deletion works without desired-state projection, CEL evaluation, GraphRevision resolution or external observation.
golang.org/x/net bumped from 0.47.0 to 0.55.0 and x/crypto to 0.52.0 in the LSP server (security update groups).

kargo@v1.12.2.text: Server logs admin logins, and optionally source IP and all requests.
Missing bindings for various RBAC permissions.

kargo@v1.12.0.text: The Connect-based gRPC API is gone, as announced in v1.9.0 and v1.11.0. Migrate integrations to the REST API before upgrading and upgrade the CLI to v1.12.0 alongside the server.
createTargetBranch removed from the git-open-pr step. Deprecated in v1.10.0; the option never worked. Remove it from promotion steps and tasks.
Image discovery trusts the right timestamp.
There will be no v1.13.0. The next minor release is v2.0.0, which replaces how Kargo stores state and how components learn about changes.

kagent@v0.10.3.text: Controller derives the full runtime image from the tag name.
